rows.question: 把现有数据每月净销售额列成趋势，月份显示YYYY-MM，订单行实付减对应退款，退款归原订单支付月份。
rows.subject: global_analyst

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: SELECT STRFTIME("fact_order"."paid_date", '%Y-%m') AS "month", SUM("fact_order_item"."amount" - COALESCE("refund_sum"."refund_amount", 0)) AS "net_sales" FROM "fact_order_item" AS "fact_order_item" JOIN "fact_order" AS "fact_order" ON "fact_order_item"."order_id" = "fact_order"."order_id" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "fact_refund"."item_id" AS "item_id", SUM("fact_refund"."amount") AS "refund_amount" FROM "fact_refund" AS "fact_refund" GROUP BY "fact_refund"."item_id") AS "refund_sum" ON "fact_order_item"."item_id" = "refund_sum"."item_id" GROUP BY STRFTIME("fact_order"."paid_date", '%Y-%m') ORDER BY "month" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 2026年9月净销售额最高的三个产品型号是什么？按金额降序，只返回型号名称和净销售额，退款扣回原支付月份。
rows.subject: global_analyst

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: SELECT "dp"."product_name" AS "product_name", SUM("foi"."amount" - COALESCE("r"."total_refund", 0)) AS "net_sales" FROM "fact_order_item" AS "foi" JOIN "fact_order" AS "fo" ON "foi"."order_id" = "fo"."order_id" JOIN "dim_sku" AS "ds" ON "foi"."sku_id" = "ds"."sku_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "ds"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "fact_refund"."item_id" AS "item_id", SUM("fact_refund"."amount") AS "total_refund" FROM "fact_refund" AS "fact_refund" GROUP BY "fact_refund"."item_id") AS "r" ON "foi"."item_id" = "r"."item_id" WHERE "fo"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."status" = '已支付' GROUP BY "dp"."product_name" ORDER BY "net_sales" DESC LIMIT 3

rows.question: 我想看2026年7月各产品型号的期末库存件数。商品和仓库分别选当月最后一次快照，不能把每日余额累加。
rows.subject: global_analyst

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: WITH "latest_inventory" AS (SELECT "f"."sku_id" AS "sku_id", "f"."warehouse_id" AS "warehouse_id", "f"."quantity" AS "quantity", "f"."stock_date" AS "stock_date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "f"."sku_id", "f"."warehouse_id" ORDER BY "f"."stock_date" DESC) AS "rn" FROM "fact_inventory_day" AS "f" WHERE "f"."stock_date" >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND "f"."stock_date" <= CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE)) SELECT "dp"."product_id" AS "product_id", "dp"."product_name" AS "product_name", SUM("li"."quantity") AS "ending_inventory_quantity" FROM "latest_inventory" AS "li" JOIN "dim_sku" AS "ds" ON "li"."sku_id" = "ds"."sku_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "ds"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" WHERE "li"."rn" = 1 GROUP BY "dp"."product_id", "dp"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_id" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 2026年7月各固件版本设备日离线率各是多少？返回固件名称、全部设备日记录数及离线百分数。
rows.subject: global_analyst

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: SELECT "df"."firmware_name" AS "firmware_name", COUNT(*) AS "total_device_days", SUM(CASE WHEN "fdd"."online" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS "offline_rate_percent" FROM "fact_device_day" AS "fdd" JOIN "dim_firmware" AS "df" ON "fdd"."firmware_id" = "df"."firmware_id" WHERE "fdd"."event_date" BETWEEN CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY "df"."firmware_name" ORDER BY "firmware_name" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 在我的仓库权限内，2026年8月各仓库采购收货数量是多少件？按收货日期汇总实际quantity。
rows.subject: regional_supply

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: SELECT "dim_warehouse"."warehouse_name" AS "warehouse_name", SUM("fact_receipt"."quantity") AS "received_units" FROM "fact_receipt" AS "fact_receipt" JOIN "dim_warehouse" AS "dim_warehouse" ON "fact_receipt"."warehouse_id" = "dim_warehouse"."warehouse_id" WHERE "fact_receipt"."receipt_date" >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND "fact_receipt"."receipt_date" < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY "dim_warehouse"."warehouse_name" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 对2026年9月售出批次，分型号列30天激活率和分子分母，排除未观察满30天样本，保留没有事件的设备。
rows.subject: global_analyst

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: WITH "sold_devices" AS (SELECT "b"."device_id" AS "device_id", "p"."product_name" AS "product_name", "o"."paid_date" AS "paid_date" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "i" ON "o"."order_id" = "i"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "b" ON "i"."item_id" = "b"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "d" ON "b"."device_id" = "d"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "p" ON "d"."product_id" = "p"."product_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE)), "activation_events" AS (SELECT "a"."device_id" AS "device_id", "a"."activation_date" AS "activation_date" FROM "fact_device_activation" AS "a" JOIN "sold_devices" AS "s" ON "a"."device_id" = "s"."device_id" WHERE "a"."activation_date" >= "s"."paid_date" AND "a"."activation_date" <= "s"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY) SELECT "s"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "s"."device_id") AS "devices", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "ae"."device_id" IS NULL THEN "s"."device_id" END) AS "matched_devices", CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT "s"."device_id") = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "ae"."device_id" IS NULL THEN "s"."device_id" END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "s"."device_id"), 2) END AS "rate_percent" FROM "sold_devices" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "activation_events" AS "ae" ON "s"."device_id" = "ae"."device_id" GROUP BY "s"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_name" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 请列2026年2月各销售渠道的净销售额并按金额降序，退款归原订单支付月份。
rows.subject: global_analyst

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: SELECT "c"."channel_name" AS "销售渠道", SUM("oi"."amount" - COALESCE("r"."refund_amount", 0)) AS "净销售额" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" JOIN "dim_channel" AS "c" ON "o"."channel_id" = "c"."channel_id" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "oi" ON "o"."order_id" = "oi"."order_id" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "fact_refund"."item_id" AS "item_id", SUM("fact_refund"."amount") AS "refund_amount" FROM "fact_refund" AS "fact_refund" GROUP BY "fact_refund"."item_id") AS "r" ON "oi"."item_id" = "r"."item_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" < CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY "c"."channel_name" ORDER BY "净销售额" DESC LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 2026年7月各型号售出设备的30天售后设备率如何？成熟观察窗满30天，去重售后设备除完整售出设备，返回型号、分母、分子和百分数。
rows.subject: global_analyst

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: WITH "sold_devices" AS (SELECT "dp"."product_name" AS "product_name", "bod"."device_id" AS "device_id", "fo"."paid_date" AS "paid_date" FROM "fact_order" AS "fo" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "foi" ON "fo"."order_id" = "foi"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "bod" ON "foi"."item_id" = "bod"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "dd" ON "bod"."device_id" = "dd"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "dd"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" WHERE "fo"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE)), "service_devices" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "sd"."product_name" AS "product_name", "sd"."device_id" AS "device_id" FROM "sold_devices" AS "sd" JOIN "fact_service_ticket" AS "fst" ON "sd"."device_id" = "fst"."device_id" WHERE "fst"."created_date" >= "sd"."paid_date" AND "fst"."created_date" <= "sd"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY) SELECT "sd"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "sd"."device_id") AS "devices", COUNT(DISTINCT "svc"."device_id") AS "matched_devices", CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT "sd"."device_id") = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT "svc"."device_id") * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "sd"."device_id"), 2) END AS "rate_percent" FROM "sold_devices" AS "sd" LEFT JOIN "service_devices" AS "svc" ON "sd"."product_name" = "svc"."product_name" AND "sd"."device_id" = "svc"."device_id" GROUP BY "sd"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_name" LIMIT 1001
